authorization: Publisher authorised three verified daily company-analysis articles on 2 November 2026, superseding the repository's one-new-article daily cap.
story_thesis: Mattel's 480-basis-point gross-margin improvement was slightly smaller than the tariff-refund contribution; durability depends on brand mix, costs and seasonal cash generation after the refund.

identity.units: USD millions except per-share data and basis points

duplicate_checks: Checked both editorial inventories, the JSON inventory and actual wealth content; Mattel has a maintained profile but no analysis separating the tariff refund from brand and margin economics.
Checked recent publication records, live content and open and merged PRs; no matching Mattel story, fingerprint or active attempt was found.
Checked the 9 November Europe/Dublin scheduled ledger before drafting; all three slots were open.
Routine quarterly results remain on /stocks/mat/; this article addresses margin quality, brand mix and cash allocation.
candidate_review_reference: See 3ee0584d66321731ed50b722.json for the ten-company screen; Mattel was selected independently.

evidence_table.claim: Q3 net sales were USD1.8067bn, up 4%, and gross margin was 54.8% versus 50.0%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release overview and Form 10-Q income statement/MD&A.

evidence_table.claim: The USD88.4m IEEPA tariff refund contributed 490 basis points to gross margin, slightly more than the 480-basis-point reported increase.
evidence_table.result: verified; refund and underlying economics separated

evidence_table.claim: Vehicles gross billings were USD679.8m, up 9%; Hot Wheels was USD585.5m, up 7%; Barbie billings declined 6%.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release category table and filing MD&A; gross billings explicitly distinguished from net sales.

evidence_table.claim: Nine-month operating cash use was USD113.5m, capex USD186.3m, share repurchases USD308.4m and Mattel163 cash acquisition cost USD74.8m net of cash acquired.
evidence_table.location_or_arithmetic: Release cash-flow section and Form 10-Q liquidity discussion.

evidence_table.claim: Full-year guidance was 1%-4% constant-currency sales growth, about 48% adjusted gross margin and USD500m-USD570m adjusted operating income, excluding tariff-refund benefits.

fact_check_pass.method: Every material number, fiscal date, category, accounting measure, management explanation and calculation was reread against the release and Form 10-Q; gross billings, GAAP and adjusted measures were kept distinct.
